flags.title: Chasing strength
flags.note: Extended — 95% up its 52-week range, RS 100, -3% from the high. Momentum isn't an edge by itself — define risk/stop before chasing.
flags.lesson: The market prices expectations; a late entry carries the drawdown, not the edge.

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through..." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 158 -> 180 Cr (TTM) but operating cash flow 182 Cr (Mar 2025) -> 174 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: The company expects a mid-teens decline in the large agricultural industry this year.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "We expect mid-teens decline in the large ag industry this year." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing in the aftermarket business.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Sep, Dec) are still in the cycle.

swot.verdict: Strengths dominate the evidence (S30/W24/O28/T17), led by 'Capital efficiency is high - the business earns well above a normal cost of capital', with 69 points of weight still sitting on the weakness, opportunity and threat side.
